description:
Beyond Nutrition is a Luxembourg-based longevity and performance supplement brand committed to scientific accuracy, transparency, and natural excellence. Natural supplements for a life of purpose.

Our Slogan: TIME TO LIVE — it is not just about embracing today and beyond, but about extending your life by maximizing your natural health span.

  • Rooted in Integrity Since 2017
    Founded by Yves Schmit out of frustration with lackluster products, Beyond Nutrition sets a higher standard for supplements—blending transparency, purpose, and science at every step. 
  • Science‑Driven, Nature‑Powered
    Our formulas are meticulously crafted using premium, proven ingredients and safe dosages. Supplements like VITALITY, RECOVERY, CREAPRO®, Magnesium and our “Essentials Stack” are designed to support overall longevity goals, energy, recovery, mindfulness, and well‑being.
  • Innovative Approach to Longevity
    We stay ahead by integrating the latest longevity science into our products. Our research base includes clinical studies and established scientific benchmarks from European health claims and high-quality reference.
  • Premium Quality, European Manufacturing
    We uphold rigorous quality control with independent testing and oversight by Luxembourg health authorities. Every product is GMO‑free, highly bioavailable, and produced in Europe with best‑in‑class standards.
  • Holistic Longevity Philosophy
    Everything we do—from product design to public content—is guided by principles of long‑term health and purposeful aging. Our "Longevity Magazine" offers deeper insight into these values. 

We want to make  a real change in our customers life and help them to perform in their prime to live a life with purpose and fulfillment.

Who are we looking for?

Any passionate longevity, lifestyle, fitness, business or adventure loving kind of people who are looking to give their best in their prime years (35-49).
payout_period: At the end of each month.
